title: Positions labelled as filled by retirees
question: Which San Francisco payroll positions are labelled as filled by retirees, and how much were they paid?
finding: 338 paid rows carry a position title naming a retiree or annuitant, $4.1 million in all; San Francisco Unified School District 2019 Day To Day Sub Teacher Retired: 172 rows, $2.2 million; San Francisco Unified School District 2021 Day To Day Sub Teacher Retired: 115 rows, $1.1 million; San Francisco Unified School District 2019 Retired Administrators Per Con: 14 rows, $306,118. Largest single row: Retired Administrators Per Con (San Francisco Unified School District, 2021) $59,505.
how: State Controller raw export: position titles containing “retired” or “annuitant”. Only positions titled this way can be found; a retiree rehired under an ordinary title cannot.
limits: Rehiring retirees for limited work is common for substitute teaching. Whether the work stayed inside the hours and earnings limits that apply to a retiree cannot be tested here: the export has no hours and no pension records. No pension data is on disk.
